focus: Angle 5 invocation mechanics: per-runtime command mirrors, seven brief adapters versus a six-row doc table, and the two universal fallbacks (name-and-ask, load-and-follow)
noveltyJustification: All 8 findings are new: this is the first iteration to enumerate runtime command mirrors, compare the hooks tree with the hook reference, and test the model-invocation assumption against repository rules.
keyQuestions: Can a model start a slash command by itself on Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Pi, Cursor, Devin and DSH, and what fallback exists where it cannot?
answeredQuestions: Can a model start a slash command by itself on Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Pi, Cursor, Devin and DSH, and what fallback exists where it cannot?
ruledOut: Giving the model the slash string so it invokes the command: no runtime exposes slash commands as model tools and no rule instructs typing one
Treating runtime parity as a per-runtime brief problem: one renderer feeds every transport, so divergence lives in command mirroring and a stale documentation row
